tracks.docweave: Freeze one configured native/provider composition and one explicit OCR baseline before executing; retain earlier model/segmentation variants separately.

tracks.boundary: Report shared-weight controlled experiments separately from each implementation native pipeline; never choose best settings using labels.

metrics.rules: Exact selected paragraphs and unique ordered pairs now. CER/WER only on complete independently labelled transcription with declared order; preserve missing/extras/failures and existing normalization.

Separate detection, row/column/span keys, positional cell text, missing/extra tables/cells. Use fixed source page and geometry-blind-to-text association. Business HTML rows are not PDF physical topology labels.

Keep placed source raster extraction separate from rendered detected figure crops. Authored placement/transform/payload controls are correctness tests, not natural-document figure recall. Freeze manually reviewed region/placement labels before paired scoring.
Fixed unique selected paragraph pairs; missing/duplicated paragraphs leave pairs unresolved. No nearest/fuzzy/best-occurrence selection.

Report cold startup/model loading separately from warm extraction, fixed CPU/thread limits and same input/resources. Separate JVM/native process memory and child OCR process memory; record host/versions. Do not derive speed/RSS rankings from historical captures.

acceptance_round.requirement: Select unseen business/scientific, historical and degraded documents using output-independent criteria; freeze independently reviewed labels and one configuration per track before either extraction. Training overlap unknown must remain disclosed.

execution_rules: JVM extraction/scoring/verification for DocWeave; Python only executes Unstructured.
Pin originals, derivation recipe/produced PDF hash, all model weights, language binaries, runtimes and exact configurations. Never crop using reference boxes before extraction.
Keep failures, duplicates, missing and extra predictions; distinguish unsupported configuration from successful empty output.
No automatic downloads, model installation, per-document oracle routing, rewritten old receipts or aggregate library accuracy percentages.
Downloaded originals and raw third-party outputs remain outside Git; commit only code, hashes, numeric outcomes and reviewed notes.
